notes: The extraction is accurate and covers the experiment, the New Zealand inspiration and the generalised skill-game idea well. The main fixes are automation scores, which were too high for an in-person staffed stand, and an assumed USD currency for the New Zealand hearsay figure. The tested and recommended price claims were missing from metric_claims and have been added. The shop revenue was largely notional, since Chris paid the fees to charity and later throws were free, which the B rating with a small-sample caveat reasonably reflects.
